title: Russia Launches 365 Missiles and Drones at Ukrainian Energy Grid
detail: Overnight Nov 2-3 Russia struck energy facilities in Odesa, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Kharkiv, Dnipro, Chernivtsi, Chernihiv and Rivne oblasts. Zelensky said 365 weapons were used (17 ballistic missiles, 59 cruise missiles, 289 attack drones); the Air Force counted 309 downed or jammed, with hits at 23 locations. Emergency and rolling blackouts continued in many cities. No casualty figure given in the source; figures differ between Zelensky and the Air Force.

media.caption: Russian strike on Ukraine's energy grid, Nov 3
